approval_required_for: Any proposed change to numeric policy or quantization intent
Any major template selection, template implementation, or architecture/design-space change

executable_actions.on_failure: Record each failed or not-run check and its artifact/constraint binding in the audit and gap artifacts. Do not claim pass, promote the inputs as verified, or silently alter numeric policy, template contents, or design-space assumptions; route the specific gap to the responsible input owner and cross-layer readiness auditor.
executable_actions.rationale: The artifact summaries establish presence but not content or check outcomes. Run the registered checks to establish traceable evidence for numeric-policy validity, template coverage, parameter binding, and template binding before SACG extraction.

observations: The state summary lists all four in-scope input artifacts, but the candidate-stage summary exposes only compact key summaries rather than the numeric policy values, template entries and metadata, or design-space parameter/resource assumptions.
No results from numeric_policy_check, template_coverage_check, parameter_binding_static_check, or template_binding_static_check are supplied; no pass is claimed.
The candidate summary reports one prepared-input error without its contents. Its relevance to these artifacts cannot be determined from the supplied summary.
sacg_memory_truth reports zero active contamination barriers and zero open retry or backtrack requests.
proposed_actions: Run all four registered static checks against the supplied numeric policy, template library and metadata, and design space; record checker-grounded findings in the numeric/template audit and binding-gap artifacts.

If a checker identifies a gap, report the specific missing or inconsistent binding for the responsible input owner. Do not create templates, select new numeric policy, change architecture, or claim implementation results.
risks: Numeric precision, quantization intent, and any tolerance or numeric claims may be unsupported or inconsistent until checked against the visible policy fields and applicable constraints.
Template availability and metadata coverage for the intended design inputs are unverified; design-space choices may not bind to supported templates.
Parameter values, legal ranges, derived parameters, and resource assumptions are not visible, so resource feasibility and traceability cannot be assessed.

Cross-layer consistency with model shape, data order, memory, runtime, implementation, and board facts is outside the evidence visible in this specialist summary and remains for the relevant checks and cross-layer auditor.

edges: artifact.input.template_library -> artifact.input.template_metadata -> constraint.template.library (availability and metadata coverage evidence required)
artifact.input.design_space -> constraint.arch.design_space (parameter binding and resource-assumption evidence required)
artifact.input.numeric_policy -> artifact.input.design_space (numeric assumptions must be consistent with selected design parameters)
